# Task packet template

```markdown
# Outcome
# Current behavior and reproduction
# Authoritative sources
# Allowed change surface
# Non-goals
# Invariants
# Risk class and failure consequence
# Acceptance evidence
# Adversarial cases or mutants
# Required return bundle
- changed files and why
- exact commands/results
- assumptions
- residual risks/surviving mutants
- rollback instructions
# Stop and escalate
# Selected historical evidence
```
